sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities. sources.snippet: Qwen3-1.7B is the model the distil labs docs tell you to start with when you have no stronger constraint. It's small enough to serve on a modest GPU, ranks mid-table after fine-tuning across eight tasks, and supports every task type the platform offers, including tool calling.
